input.quote: (iv) and each Party will return or destroy any of the other Party's Confidential Information then in its possession.
input.rationale: Section 4(c) is the only effect-of-termination provision: Kubient ceases the Services, the licence is revoked, Customer stops using the Auction Platform, and each Party may "return or destroy" the other's Confidential Information at its own election. There is no transition-assistance obligation and no right for AP to receive its Content, Requests or other data back in a usable format, and no deletion certification; searches for transition/migration/export/data-return language return nothing elsewhere in the Agreement. Because Kubient could elect destruction, this sits at or near the walk-away position (no data return / immediate deletion), failing even the fallback (90 days' assistance plus export within 30 days). We therefore insert a new paragraph 4(c)(v) reflecting the preferred position — up to six months' assistance at then-current rates, machine-readable return within 30 days, then deletion with written certification — expressly overriding the destroy option for Customer Data, and flag the 90-day fallback in the comment.

proposal.summary: Insert post-termination transition assistance and data-return obligation in Section 4(c)
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have added a short exit provision so that, on termination, we can obtain reasonable transition assistance (up to six months at Kubient's then-current rates) and a copy of our data in a machine-readable format before it is deleted. As drafted, Section 4(c)(iv) lets Kubient simply destroy our information, which leaves us unable to migrate; we can accept a 90-day assistance period if six months is difficult.

ops.text: (v) at Customer's request, Kubient shall (A) provide reasonable transition assistance for up to six (6) months following termination or expiration at Kubient's then-current rates; (B) within thirty (30) days of such request, return or deliver to Customer, in a commonly used, machine-readable format, all Content, Requests and other data of, or relating to, Customer or its Properties in Kubient's possession or control ("Customer Data"); and (C) thereafter delete such Customer Data from its systems and certify such deletion in writing. Kubient's obligations under this paragraph 4(c)(v) shall take precedence over paragraph 4(c)(iv) with respect to Customer Data.
